Wine-Braised Beef with Onions

Yield: 6 servings

Ingredients
- 2 pounds beef chuck roast
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 large onions
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tablespoons tomato paste
- 1 cup red wine
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 teaspoon kosher salt

Preparation
1. Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Brown the beef for 6 minutes, turning occasionally, until deeply colored.
3. Add the onions, garlic, tomato paste, thyme and salt. Cook 5 minutes until soft.
4. Pour in the wine and broth. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours until fork-tender.
